prompt: What is the difference between Git and GitHub, and why might a .gitignore file be useful?
failureMessage: Your step 1 answer needs a bit more. Please write 2–4 full sentences in your own words covering: (1) what Git does, (2) what GitHub adds on top of Git, and (3) why .gitignore is useful. Try explaining each idea as you would to a colleague who has not used Git before.
